data.label: Hire CRO Above VP of Sales

pass2.reasoning: A structured coaching programme usually yields modest improvements in sales execution quality over 90 days in B2B organizations.
Demonstrating development support for the VP tends to reduce board confidence erosion risk.
Elevating to a CRO typically enhances sales execution capabilities relative to status quo.
Adding a new CRO layer often increases attrition risk among account executives wary of leadership changes.
Board confidence may erode if a CRO hire is seen as lack of faith in existing leadership.
Readiness for the October product launch is a key driver of mid-term ARR growth trajectory.
Successful launch readiness typically reduces board confidence erosion risk ahead of key milestones.
Replacing the VP can modestly improve sales execution after initial ramp-up.
A leadership replacement often drives up attrition risk among sales staff.
Replacing the VP is likely to cause substantial short-term transition disruption.
Higher AE team morale generally leads to better sales execution quality.
Improved team morale typically reduces attrition risk among account executives.
The VP’s scalability capability is a strong determinant of future ARR growth.
The inherent scalability of the VP in enterprise sales directly drives execution quality.
ARR growth trajectory directly determines the likelihood of achieving the £6m ARR goal.
Sales execution quality causally feeds into ARR target achievement.
Higher AE attrition risk reduces the probability of hitting ARR growth targets.
An erosion in board confidence can stall strategic initiatives needed for ARR growth.
Leadership transition disruption risk negatively impacts the ability to achieve growth targets.
